findings.text: The design has web format last_visit_at 'in the hospital time zone', but HOSPITAL_TZ is only documented as API config. No cited fact shows how the web gets the zone, or that dateTime/Next appointment already uses it. This leaves REQ-3/REQ-4 (S-1 AC3/AC4) resting on an unstated assumption.
